instruments.name: Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act 4 of 2013)
Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000

facet_hints.conditions: POPIA is structured around eight conditions for lawful processing; map obligations to those conditions rather than to GDPR articles.
facet_hints.information_officer: POPIA requires an Information Officer, with registration with the Regulator; confirm the current registration process.
facet_hints.special_categories: POPIA special personal information, including the separate regime for children's data.
facet_hints.cross_border: Section 72 governs transborder flows; confirm the permitted grounds.
facet_hints.direct_marketing: Section 69 governs direct marketing by electronic communication and is opt-in; this catches many products.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search Information Regulator enforcement notices and infringement notices.

seed_obligations.title: Meet the eight conditions for lawful processing
applies_when: processes personal information of data subjects in South Africa
testable_as: retention limits with a deletion path

seed_obligations.title: Designate and register an Information Officer
applies_when: is a responsible party under POPIA
testable_as: evidence of registration with the Regulator

seed_obligations.title: Meet the grounds for transferring personal information outside South Africa
testable_as: a recorded s72 ground per destination

seed_obligations.title: Notify the Regulator and data subjects of a security compromise
applies_when: a security compromise affecting personal information occurs
testable_as: an incident runbook naming the Regulator

seed_obligations.title: Obtain consent before electronic direct marketing
applies_when: sends marketing by email, SMS or automatic calling machine
testable_as: an opt-in consent record per recipient
